title: Fillink submission
description: Draft envelope for structured form data linked to a versioned template.

formatVersion.description: Version of the Fillink submission envelope format.

uri.description: Stable identifier for the template, not necessarily a directly fetchable URL.

sha256.description: Optional lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the exact template artifact bytes.

data.description: The form answers. Validate against the data schema published by the referenced template.

locked.description: Whether the viewer should make the submission read-only. This is an application state flag, not tamper protection or proof of signing.
